about: Every tool's page in docs/tools/, generated by python -m kit.tooldocs index from the pages; edit the pages, not this file. The standard is docs/TOOL-DOCS.md.

tools.title: kit auc: pixel AUC of an ink map against a segment's published labels
tools.summary: Scores a 2D ink map against a segment's `inklabels.zarr` inside its `supervision.zarr`, with the reverse-depth map as the control, block-bootstrap intervals and a paired comparison of two maps.
tools.released: Public `main` since 2026-10-07; also in the AutoPipeline release
tools.guide: [STANDARDS.md](../STANDARDS.md) (how AUC is used here), [the overlap and baseline log](../logs/2026-10-07-overlap-and-baseline.md) (sampling noise)
